primary.scope: Continuous Host-ready interval: trace_ms minus measured final release/drain interval; all requests and complete ID/FP32 field materialization plus ACK fences retained. primary.legacy_secondary: trace_ms including final state enumeration and service release, identical previous mixed scope

qualification.edges: N4096 duplicated initial vectors, query around insert/base and buffer deletion/rebuild; N255 delete-to-zero, empty range/K padding and insert-to-one; independent bounded exhaustive oracle. Target uses pinned prior native oracle

diagnostic.scope: One NSYS full target workflow per backend, diagnostic only. P2 measured native.trace; E measured span bound to second full database upload and final release. decision: Report paired geometric P2/E with bootstrap 95% CI, P2 wins/6 (<1), order strata, marginal medians and raw values. <=1.2 competitive, 1.5..3 material gap, >3 large gap; classify measured component excess without claiming a causal pruning limit
stop: First runtime, full output, provenance, isolation or sanitizer failure; no replacement/rerun or implementation repair. Retain every failed and unexecuted job
disclosures: Existing exact qualified binaries are reused by hash rather than rebuilt; sources/build/tool/library provenance reverified
